title: PR Viewer
description: Reviews in the dock: this session's linked reviews with their stacks, the checkout's others, a detail view with checks, labels, review threads and the diff, link/unlink, and merge or rebase-stack. Vendor-neutral by construction (doc 73 §1) — a pull request, a merge request or a Swarm review ride the same rows; the label on each row is the host's own. Declares `opens: ["review"]`, so a rail chip's act("openReview") lands here while this pack is installed and opens the browser when it is not; the chip never knows which.
